title: Acquirer: Arnotts Biscuits Ltd; Target: Snack Foods Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Arnott's Biscuits Limited proposes to acquire Snack Foods Limited
body_sections.Market definition: The National Markets for the manufacture and distribution of: salty snacks; biscuits; and chocolate confectionery.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Salty snacks The Commission considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to lead to a substantial lessening of competition in the market for salty snacks due to: - continued competition from large competitors; and - the countervailing power exercised by the parties' large customers. Biscuits The Commission considered that it appeared that the proposed acquisition would not substantially lessen competiton due to: - the target's market share appeared to be of a size that may not be considered to be substantial - the Commission considered that there is a real potential of entry by international biscuit suppliers that is likely to restrain the post-acquisition entity; and - the countervailing power exercised by the parties' large customers. Chocolate confectionary The Commission considered that it appeared that the parties had small market shares and accordingly, the Commission considered that a substantial lessening of competition was unlikely.
